name: Narin
description: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.

details.passiveDescription: Each stack of Cold Status Effect on enemies increases the chance to spawn a Sangodae pickup by 1%, granting extra Cold damage on Primary and Secondary weapons for 10 seconds. Narin also gains Cold damage for her abilities.
